# Vireo XS (`vireo_xs`) — spec sheet

| Compact | late-90s Japanese FF hot hatch, 1.6 L naturally aspirated I4 with two-stage cam | 2 / 5 | 7,500 |

## Design note

The beater-tier hero: light, eager and cheap to fix. It is slow in a straight line but carries speed through traffic, and its high-revving four rewards keeping it above the cam crossover. Front-heavy FF balance with a stiff rear bar gives lift-off rotation for players who learn it; everyone else gets safe understeer.

## How this car breaks

Thin 90s unibody with modest crumple zones. Plastic bumpers and the steel hood crumple at parking-lot speeds; the transverse engine sits right behind the radiator so a 40 km/h nose hit already cooks the cooling pack. The cabin is acceptable for its era but the A-pillars fold in a hard offset hit, so in Simulation one committed frontal at speed is the end of it.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for late-90s 1.6 L FF hatches (mass, dimensions, gearing)
- owner chassis-dyno averages for the high-rev two-stage-cam 1.6 engine family
- engineering tables: tire size → radius, ride-frequency spring sizing, brake torque from caliper hydraulics

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 445 | 0.80 | 360 |
| pitch | 1814 | 0.90 | 1630 |
| yaw | 1907 | 0.92 | 1750 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.84·W·H = 1.95 m²; Cd = 0.33 → **CdA = 0.644 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.10 / +0.12 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

1.6 L DOHC 16-valve I4, naturally aspirated, two-stage variable cam (crossover ~5300 rpm). Class-typical specific output for a late-90s non-flagship high-rev 1.6 (~61 kW/L); the torque step at the cam crossover is the signature of owner dyno sheets for this engine family.

Peak **97 kW @ 7000 rpm**, **144 N·m @ 6000 rpm**. Idle 800 / redline 7600 / limiter 7900 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.10 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 17 N·m. Power-to-weight 87 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

5-speed manual, open front differential. Layout **FWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 200 N·m. Shift time 0.25 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.23 | 14.21 | 58 |
| 2 | 1.90 | 8.36 | 99 |
| 3 | 1.27 | 5.59 | 148 |
| 4 | 0.97 | 4.27 | 194 |
| 5 | 0.78 | 3.43 | 241 |

Final drive 4.40, reverse 3.00. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.289 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 331 kg | 1.55 Hz | 31400 N/m | 1930 N·s/m | 2900 N·s/m | 0.16 m |
| Rear | 198 kg | 1.70 Hz | 22600 N/m | 1270 N·s/m | 1900 N·s/m | 0.17 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 3.0°/g with 42% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.405 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 85322 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 34125 F / 24543 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **800 F / 11500 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 3.0°/g, front share 42%. Bump stops 150000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.5° F / -1.0° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 3.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 262 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm → A = 22.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 106 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·22.9 cm²·0.106 m = **1845 N·m**
- Rear: 239 mm disc, pistons per side 34 mm → A = 9.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 94 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·9.1 cm²·0.095 m = **652 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1292 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.43×), rear needs 301 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.16×). `bias_front` = f + 0.9·h/L = 0.78 (ideal distribution at 0.9 g, clamped 0.55-0.78). Handbrake 600 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 10.0 m → outer-front path radius 4.90 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.41 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.656 rad (37.6°)** (outer 32.3°, inner 44.5° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.5 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/vireo_xs.json`)

120 nodes, 704 beams, 3 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-box-lattice --id vireo_xs --width 1.695 --length 4.18 --height 1.37 --wheelbase 2.62 --mass 247.5 --clearance 0.14` (22% of vehicle mass).
- Shaped top layer to the `hatch` profile (hood/deck/bumper tops dropped to beltline, greenhouse narrowed to 86% width).

- Beams: cabin cell → hss 3.5e-04 m² (88 beams).
- Beams: sills → hss 4.0e-04 m² (6 beams).
- Beams: crumple (outer) rail segments → hss 3.0e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: inner rail segments / firewall → hss 4.0e-04 m² (36 beams).
- Beams: hood → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (16 beams).
- Beams: outer panels → mild_steel 1.5e-04 m² (284 beams).
- Components: radiator at row 8 ahead of the engine (fails first), transverse engine at row 7 with the gearbox on its left end, fuel tank under the rear seat.
- Detachables: FrontBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, RearBumper 3000 N·s / 6 kg, Hood 5000 N·s / 15 kg.
- Node mass: engine-mount nodes ×2.5, renormalised to 248 kg total.
